name: Vignette overlay
summary: Full-frame dark radial vignette that pulls the eye to the centre, with an optional slow breathe.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: breathe
params.note: slowly swells and eases the darkness

params.name: seed
params.note: change when two vignettes are in one shot

params.name: color
params.note: shadow colour; default the style ink

author: krakujs
